intended_object: The (Galois) action of Aut_R(A) on the affine coordinate ring A[W] = A[X,Y]/(W) of a Weierstrass curve W defined over R and base-changed to A: σ acts on coefficients and fixes x and y, giving a group homomorphism Aut_R(A) → RingAut(A[W]). Inferred from docstring and module documentation.
explanation: The body uses AdjoinRoot.mapRingEquiv along Polynomial.mapEquiv σ on A[X] (the base ring of the bivariate Weierstrass polynomial in A[X][Y]). This is well defined because the base-changed polynomial has coefficients coming from R, so σ fixes it (Affine.baseChange_polynomial). The library's lemmas _mk, _of, _root and _algebraMap confirm the behaviour: a class [p] goes to [p with σ applied to its coefficients], x and y are fixed, and constants a go to σ(a). map_one' and map_mul' make σ ↦ action a covariant monoid homomorphism, the correct convention for a left action. The generality is natural: any commutative ring R, any R-algebra A, and all R-algebra automorphisms. The only special structure used is that W is defined over R, which the construction needs. I found no Mathlib counterpart.
